scripts.postinstall: node -e "if(process.platform==='linux' && process.env.RENDER==='true'){const{execSync}=require('child_process');try{console.log('Render Linux detectado: Reinstalando sharp...');execSync('npm uninstall sharp && npm install sharp',{stdio:'inherit',cwd:__dirname})}catch(e){console.error('Falló la reinstalación de sharp:',e)}}"
